preconditions.description: The number of plates n must be between 1 and 2000.
The integers a and b representing the maximum number of plates that can be moved in each operation must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(sizes) == n and all(1 <= size <= n for size in sizes)
preconditions.description: The list of plate sizes must contain exactly n distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output must start with 'YES' followed by the number of operations and the operations themselves.
If no solution exists, the output must be 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(t == 1 and 1 <= c <= a for t, c in operations) and any(t == 2 and 1 <= c <= b for t, c in operations)
postconditions.description: The operations must include valid moves from the dirty stack to the intermediate stack and from the intermediate stack to the dryer.
